name: Vendor Maintenance vs Payment Approval
description: The identity would be able to create a fictitious vendor and approve payments to it.

name: Journal Posting vs Period Close
description: The identity would be able to post entries and then close the period, concealing the entry.

name: Expense Submission vs Expense Approval
description: The identity would be able to submit and approve their own expense claims.

name: Customer Invoicing vs Payment Approval
description: The identity would control both sides of the cash cycle.

name: Warehouse Administration vs Personal Data Access
description: The identity could grant themselves personal data access and remove the audit trail.

name: Workforce Administration vs Compensation Visibility
description: The identity could alter their own compensation record and view the results.

name: SAP Administration vs Financial Posting
description: The identity could post financial entries and suppress the system audit log.

name: Retired CRM Administration Conflict
description: Superseded rule retained for audit history. Disabled, and must never be evaluated.
